_comment: S-A section/entity/join event vectors (card t_00fda230): pins the SectionActivated / EntityInteract / PlayerSelection vocabulary on the REAL WorldEventFeed.Append path (fail-loud kind/key validation, same discipline as door_feed.json for R-A). expect blocks recorded once via `dotnet run -- <fixtures> --record` and reviewed. Reviewed canon shows the S-A law: the new kinds move the history hash but leave NO trace in the projected view (WorldEventVector.Project has no case for them - audit-trail facts; S-B/S-D add consumers later). The adapter-side polling dedup (snapshot diff through the live accessors TileManager.IsMapSectionActive / MapEntityManager.GetEntity, first-sight resync claims, restore-copy correctness) lives in WorldEventsUnity.PollSections/PollEntities and is NOT reproducible in Core - the event lists below are what one observed flip produces, one per flip.

cases.name: sa_section_interact_roundtrip
cases.comment: Section reveals, then a terminal flips active inside the visible section: one SectionActivated per reveal, one EntityInteract per flip (direction rides the 'active' payload key, section anchor = the entity's own mapSectionOwner GUID). Replay bit-identical; projected canon free of section/interact traces.

cases.comment: The concept 5.4 join SHAPE inside one stream: PlayerSelection (button text as name) directly followed by the EntityInteract it caused (seq adjacency, same round).
